children: Brazil's Finance Minister Dario Durigan said on Thursday he will hold a follow-up meeting with President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva later in the day to discuss additional fiscal measures aimed at curbing spending.

Speaking at an event hosted by XP in Sao Paulo, he said the government should take advantage of its strong relationship with Congress this year to approve a constitutional amendment and additional proposals.
